val val token a validator reward token for the sora network used to reward validators and stake nominators. val has deflationary tokenomics with tokens burned on every transaction, and elastic rewards distributed as a percentage of daily burned tokens. val token xor pswap validator staking deflationary hashi xor pswap validator staking deflationary hashi

pswap pswap token a deflationary token used to reward liquidity providers on polkaswap. pswap has a 10 billion max supply that decreases over time, with 0.3% trading fees used for buyback-and-burn, and rewards starting at 90% of burned tokens reminted for lps, decreasing to 35% after 5 years. pswap token xor val polkaswap dex liquidity deflationary xor val polkaswap dex liquidity deflationary buyback-and-burn

polkaswap polkaswap defi a next-generation, cross-chain liquidity aggregator dex protocol built on sora network. polkaswap aggregates liquidity from multiple sources (amm dexs, order books, algorithms) and provides smart liquidity routing to find the best prices. it enables seamless trading of eth/erc-20 tokens, dot/ksm, btc, and future assets with high speed, low fees, and reduced impermanent loss through its unique liquidity infrastructure. polkaswap defi dex cross-chain pswap dex cross-chain liquidity aggregation pswap smart routing sora network

sora parliament sora-parliament governance the democratic governance system of sora using multi-body sortition with clear separation of powers. citizens are randomly selected (not token voting) and must post xor bonds for citizenship. features multiple bodies: rules committee, agenda council, interest panels, review panel, and policy jury. main task is allocating newly minted xor to productive projects. sora parliament governance xor val sortition citizenship supranational sora parliament xor val sortition citizenship multi-body governance supranational

hyperledger iroha hyperledger-iroha technology an open-source, permissioned blockchain framework developed by soramitsu and part of the hyperledger foundation. designed for simplicity and fast deployment with granular permissions, built-in asset management, and byzantine fault tolerant consensus. iroha 2 (written in rust) adds wasm smart contracts and improved performance, making it suitable for enterprise systems, cbdcs, and national-level financial infrastructure. hyperledger iroha technology soramitsu cbdc enterprise wasm hyperledger iroha soramitsu hyperledger foundation permissioned blockchain cbdc enterprise wasm

substrate substrate technology a modular blockchain framework developed by parity technologies. sora v2 uses substrate to integrate with the polkadot ecosystem and enable cross-chain functionality, while sora v3 is migrating away from substrate to hyperledger iroha for improved efficiency and enterprise integration. substrate technology polkadot parachain cross-chain polkadot parachain cross-chain sora v2 sora v3 hyperledger iroha

parachain parachain network a parallel blockchain in the polkadot ecosystem that connects to the main relay chain and benefits from shared security. parachains can specialize in specific use cases (defi, privacy, smart contracts) while maintaining interoperability through cross-consensus messaging (xcm). they process transactions in parallel and are validated by the relay chain's validator set. parachain network polkadot xcm cross-chain polkadot relay chain xcm shared security parallel processing cross-chain

cbdc cbdc economics central bank digital currency - a digital form of a country's fiat currency issued by the central bank. soramitsu has successfully deployed multiple cbdcs including cambodia's bakong (8.5m users, $15.5m in payments), lao cbdc pilot, and fiji cbdc exploration. these blockchain-based systems enable financial inclusion, cross-border remittances, and interoperable digital payments. cbdc economics soramitsu bakong soramitsu bakong digital currency central bank financial inclusion cross-border payments

bakong bakong economics cambodia's national digital payment system built on blockchain technology by soramitsu. bakong is one of the most successful cbdc implementations, with over 20 million users and $70 billion in transactions, demonstrating the potential of blockchain-based digital currencies. bakong economics cbdc soramitsu cbdc soramitsu digital currency financial inclusion cross-border payments

soramitsu soramitsu network a japanese fintech company that develops blockchain infrastructure and digital identity solutions. soramitsu is the company behind the sora network and has implemented successful cbdc projects including cambodia's bakong and lao cbdc pilot. soramitsu network cbdc bakong sora network cbdc bakong hyperledger iroha blockchain infrastructure

polkadot polkadot network a heterogeneous multi-chain network that enables different blockchains to transfer messages and value in a trust-free fashion. polkadot provides shared security, cross-chain interoperability, and parallel processing through its relay chain and parachain architecture. polkadot network parachain xcm cross-chain substrate parachain relay chain xcm shared security cross-chain substrate

blockchain blockchain technology a distributed ledger technology that maintains a continuously growing list of records secured using cryptography. sora operates on blockchain technology, currently using substrate framework and transitioning to hyperledger iroha for enhanced enterprise capabilities. blockchain technology cryptography substrate distributed ledger cryptography substrate hyperledger iroha decentralization

token bonding curve token-bonding-curve economics a smart contract that manages the supply of xor in a rational way without human involvement. the tbc automatically adjusts xor supply based on economic conditions to maintain price stability, expanding supply during growth and contracting during decline. token bonding curve economics xor token bonding curve xor elastic supply smart contract price stability supply management

referendum referendum governance a democracy referenda in sora's current governance system (polkadot v1 governance). after a council motion is approved by the sora council, it becomes a democracy referenda where the entire community can vote on specific proposals, parameter changes, or network upgrades. referendum governance democracy sora council council motion polkadot governance democracy

elastic supply elastic-supply economics a monetary policy where token supply automatically adjusts based on economic conditions and demand. unlike conventional tokenomics with limited supply, sora's xor uses elastic supply managed by the token bonding curve (tbc) smart contract without human involvement. the tbc manages xor supply rationally to maintain price stability, with the supply expanding or contracting based on market conditions and economic activity. elastic supply economics xor elastic supply xor token bonding curve monetary policy price stability smart contract economic conditions

sora v3 sora-v3 technology the latest version of sora built on hyperledger iroha 2, featuring the sora v3 hub chain that enables seamless collaboration between permissioned and decentralized systems. designed for cbdcs, government integration, and economic sovereignty while maintaining borderless financial activities. sora v3 technology cbdc kusd sora hyperledger iroha cbdc hub chain economic sovereignty kusd fujiwara testnet

fujiwara testnet fujiwara-testnet technology the first testnet for sora v3, named after the influential fujiwara family that shaped japan's heian period. this crucial milestone enables experimentation with key sora v3 features including defi capabilities, sora parliament governance, and network stability testing. as the first public blockchain implementation of iroha-based infrastructure, it provides valuable insights for the transition from private to public blockchain features. fujiwara testnet technology defi governance fujiwara testnet sora v3 hyperledger iroha sora parliament defi governance public blockchain

yield farming yield-farming defi a defi strategy where users provide liquidity to protocols and earn rewards. in polkaswap, users can farm pswap tokens by providing liquidity to xyk pools, with rewards distributed through the platform's liquidity aggregation system. polkaswap's unique infrastructure reduces impermanent loss risks while providing competitive yields through multi-source liquidity aggregation. yield farming defi pswap yield farming liquidity provision pswap xyk pools liquidity aggregation impermanent loss

impermanent loss impermanent-loss defi a temporary loss of value that can occur when providing liquidity to automated market makers (amms) due to price volatility of the paired assets. for example, if you provide 1 eth and 2000 usdc to a pool, and eth price doubles, you may end up with fewer eth tokens when withdrawing due to the automated rebalancing. impermanent loss defi liquidity amm risk impermanent loss liquidity amm price volatility risk

integrated plan integrated-plan governance a comprehensive development roadmap for the sora ecosystem separated into business, backend, web, and mobile/other tracks. the plan tracks development progress with completion percentages and includes key milestones like sora v3 network launch, sora parliament implementation, and cross-chain infrastructure development. integrated plan governance cross-chain infrastructure integrated plan sora v3 sora parliament development roadmap cross-chain infrastructure

smart contract smart-contract technology self-executing contracts with the terms of the agreement directly written into code. in sora, smart contracts like the token bonding curve automatically manage token supply and economic parameters without human intervention. smart contract technology automation code blockchain smart contract token bonding curve automation code blockchain

deflationary deflationary economics a tokenomic model where the total supply of tokens decreases over time. in sora, both val and pswap are deflationary tokens - val tokens are burned on every network transaction, while pswap tokens are burned on every polkaswap transaction, creating scarcity and potential value appreciation. deflationary economics val pswap scarcity val pswap token burning scarcity supply reduction

buyback-and-burn buyback-and-burn economics a tokenomic mechanism where tokens are purchased from the market and permanently destroyed. pswap uses a buyback-and-burn model where 0.3% of trading fees are used to buy pswap tokens from the market and burn them, reducing total supply and potentially increasing token value. buyback-and-burn economics pswap deflationary pswap deflationary token burning trading fees supply reduction

liquidity aggregation liquidity-aggregation defi a technology that combines liquidity from multiple sources (amm dexs, order books, algorithms) to provide better prices and reduced slippage. polkaswap uses advanced liquidity aggregation to source the best prices from various liquidity pools and trading venues. liquidity aggregation defi polkaswap multi-source liquidity aggregation polkaswap liquidity pool smart routing price optimization multi-source

smart routing smart-routing defi an algorithm that automatically finds the optimal path for trading to minimize slippage and maximize returns. polkaswap's smart routing analyzes multiple liquidity sources and automatically routes trades through the best available pools to provide optimal pricing. smart routing defi polkaswap algorithm smart routing polkaswap liquidity aggregation price optimization slippage reduction algorithm

sortition sortition governance a governance mechanism where participants are randomly selected to make decisions, rather than through voting or token holdings. the sora parliament uses sortition as one of its core principles, randomly choosing citizens to participate in governance bodies, ensuring fair representation and preventing plutocracy. sortition governance democracy citizenship sora parliament governance random selection democracy citizenship

hashi hashi technology sora's decentralized and trustless cross-chain bridge that enables secure asset transfers between ethereum and sora networks. hashi uses cryptographic proofs to validate transactions across chains, allowing users to move erc-20 tokens between ethereum and sora mainnet without centralized intermediaries. the bridge is integrated with polkaswap for seamless cross-chain trading. hashi technology cross-chain bridges ethereum erc-20 polkaswap trustless cross-chain bridges interoperability ethereum erc-20 polkaswap trustless

citizenship citizenship governance a status in the sora parliament governance system where individuals become citizens by posting xor bonds. citizens are randomly selected through sortition to participate in various governance bodies and make decisions about xor allocation to productive projects. citizenship governance xor sortition bond sora parliament xor sortition governance bond

xyk pools xyk-pools defi constant product market maker (cpmm) liquidity pools where the product of two token reserves remains constant (x * y = k). these are the primary liquidity pools on polkaswap where users can provide liquidity and earn pswap rewards through yield farming. xyk pools defi polkaswap pswap xyk pools polkaswap liquidity pool yield farming pswap constant product

financial inclusion financial-inclusion economics the principle of providing access to financial services to individuals and businesses who are excluded from traditional banking. cbdc implementations like cambodia's bakong promote financial inclusion by providing digital payment infrastructure to underserved populations. financial inclusion economics cbdc financial inclusion cbdc digital payments banking access underserved populations

cross-border payments cross-border-payments economics financial transactions between parties in different countries. cbdc implementations like bakong enable faster, cheaper, and more efficient cross-border remittances by using blockchain technology to reduce intermediaries and settlement times. cross-border payments economics cbdc remittances blockchain cross-border payments cbdc remittances international transfer blockchain

economic conditions economic-conditions economics market factors and economic indicators that influence token supply and demand. in sora's elastic supply model, the token bonding curve responds to economic conditions by adjusting xor supply - expanding during growth periods and contracting during decline to maintain price stability. economic conditions economics economic conditions elastic supply token bonding curve price stability market conditions

parallel processing parallel-processing technology the ability to process multiple transactions simultaneously across different blockchain networks. polkadot parachains enable parallel processing by allowing multiple parachains to process transactions in parallel, significantly increasing overall network throughput compared to sequential processing. parallel processing technology parachain polkadot throughput scalability parallel processing parachain polkadot throughput scalability

token burning token-burning economics the permanent removal of tokens from circulation by sending them to an unrecoverable address. in sora, token burning is used as a deflationary mechanism - val tokens are burned on every network transaction, and pswap tokens are burned on every polkaswap transaction to reduce supply over time. token burning economics val pswap deflationary scarcity token burning val pswap deflationary supply reduction scarcity

price stability price-stability economics the maintenance of relatively stable token prices over time through economic mechanisms. sora's token bonding curve maintains xor price stability by automatically adjusting supply based on market conditions - expanding supply during price increases and contracting during price decreases. price stability economics price stability elastic supply token bonding curve economic conditions supply management
